# Credit Loan Risk Assessment Update

This document details immediate actions required for the Credit & Loans department's risk assessment processes:

*   Investigate the default risk standard update.
*   Update the collateral value based on audit findings.
*   Monitor interest rates for the 2026 strategy.
*   Monitor interest rates quarterly.
*   Review collateral value quarterly.
